This original 52-byte fixture was encoded directly from Adobe's documented PSD version 1 header and planar raw composite layout. It contains no layers, resources or color metadata. It was not produced by ag-psd or any parser/converter under test.

The full-resolution 2 by 2 RGB pixels, in top-to-bottom row order, are red, green, blue and white. All pixels are opaque. Source specification: https://www.adobe.com/devnet-apps/photoshop/fileformatashtml/ . The independent PNG decoder acceptance checks compare these literal pixels.
